df['Sex of respondent, 1979'] = df['Sex of respondent, 1979'].astype('category')

# Perform a t-test to compare the mean highest grade completed between males and females
import scipy.stats as stats

# Filter the data by gender
males = df[df['Sex of respondent, 1979'] == 1]['Highest grade completed, 1979']
females = df[df['Sex of respondent, 1979'] == 2]['Highest grade completed, 1979']

# Perform the t-test
t_stat, p_value = stats.ttest_ind(males, females)
t_stat, p_value
